sections.heading: Overview
bullets: Escort Scholar Glenna along the route to white circles, where she summons Ley Lines to progress, while securing towers along the way. No time limit — it fails if Glenna dies or the squad wipes.

sections.heading: Protecting Glenna
bullets: One player is assigned to babysit Glenna — using a special action key to keep her moving and protected, and staying within 1,000 range so her Surveilled stacks (starts at 15) don't run out. Zero stacks is a squad wipe, full stop.

Once all towers are captured, two Warg Bloodhounds spawn at the front and back of the route and fixate on Glenna for heavy damage — assign a DPS to each Warg (or coordinate both at once) rather than letting one go unchecked.

Mines along the path only become targetable once a player walks into their larger white circle — the smaller red circle instantly kills anyone standing in it. Strike from the outer ring with ranged damage instead of walking up to them.

sections.heading: Tower captures
bullets: Three common approaches: kill enough mobs that players outnumber defenders, portal the squad straight into the capture zone (Mesmer + Mass Invisibility is the clean way to avoid aggro), or solo-push mobs out of the circle.
Coordinate so the squad isn't spread too thin across towers at once.
